person_updates.identity_evidence: The visually verified index supplies Guy E. Carpenter, Box 108, archive location, and a restricted identifier. No exact restricted-identifier or exact-name Army bulk row was found. Exact-name OSS, official, Library of Congress, employment, obituary, institutional, newspaper, directory, and archival searches produced no defensible identity bridge; a 1934 property-transfer namesake lacks wartime linkage.
person_updates.next_action: Review Box 108 to determine Guy E. Carpenter's military or civilian status, identity anchors, pre-OSS affiliation, and employer. No reliable pre-OSS employer has yet been identified in the accessible sources reviewed.
